headline: Board r41: analog stage on the top (one-sided JLC assembly), feedback taken at the output pin so any receiver input reads right (simulated), watchdog in the firmware, fab files exported and checked part by part. Nothing ordered or built; outside audit round 4 is next, then your JLC quote.

tests.what: Pull C17 toward the op-amp on the old small board (placement weight).
tests.result: 6 open connections: reverted. Showed the small board was the limit.

tests.what: Grow 15 mm, stage into the strip, add R11, keep all upstream tracks.
tests.result: 0 new / 0 open first try. Layout review: CAN_L ran 0.3 mm beside the output for 6.8 mm.

tests.what: Move the CAN terminator off the output's corridor.
tests.result: Coupling clean (nothing within 1 mm). C17 still 6.1 mm from its pin.

tests.what: Start C17/C15 on the right side of the chip; tie caps to their pins.
tests.result: 0/0/0, no review flags; C17 2.1 mm, C15 2.3 mm. Current board.

tests.what: Separate analog ground for J3-7 on the board (heater current shares the ground wires).
tests.result: No board change (your decision). Bring-up test A4 measures the real ground offset.

tests.what: Mounting holes in the new bottom corners for your enclosure.
tests.result: Done r37: two M3 holes; r41 keeps copper 3.6 mm clear of them.

tests.what: Put the analog stage on the top of the strip for one-sided (cheaper) JLC assembly.
tests.result: Done r37: every SMD part on the top. Economic $8 setup vs $50 two-sided (JLC help, 2025-09).

tests.what: R9 (op-amp supply resistor) 0603 to 1206 for long surges.
Stage to the top; feedback from J3-5 after R11; R9 1206; M3 holes.
tests.result: 0 new DRC, 0 open; PWM return gap 4.1 mm (C7 cleared).

tests.what: Merge same-net vias drilled too close; DRC check counts fab warnings.
tests.result: Found a hole_to_hole pair hidden since about r26; fixed.

tests.what: Silkscreen at JLC minimum, labels only where they belong; fab export.
tests.result: 11-12 labels, TEST and 120R on the jumpers; BOM 25 lines, CPL 38 parts.

tests.what: Rotation, origin and pin names from each part's EasyEDA footprint.
tests.result: 4 rotation fixes, U2 shifted 0.725 mm, D2 would have gone on backwards by pad number: fixed.

tests.what: No copper under the screw heads.
tests.result: Pour was 0.3 mm from the holes; now 3.6 mm.
0 B RAM, 5 host tests, bench self-test build W1.

tests.what: Codex audit of r41 and the fab files.
JLC quote and placement preview (your money call).
